===migrations/0001_auth.sql
-- Better Auth schema (identity + sessions for "Sign in with Grok").
--
-- Generated by the Better Auth CLI for its Postgres adapter — DO NOT EDIT by
-- hand. `@/lib/auth/server` runs Better Auth against these tables when
-- DATABASE_URL is set. The columns are camelCase and MUST stay double-quoted so
-- Postgres preserves the case Better Auth queries by.
--
-- Migrations in this folder are the single source of truth for your schema. They
-- apply to Neon during the Vercel build (`npm run build`) and to the local
-- PGLite fallback automatically on startup, so dev matches production. Applied
-- files are recorded by name in `_migrations` and NEVER run again.
--
-- Put YOUR app's schema in NEW ordered files (0002_*.sql, 0003_*.sql, …), never
-- in this one. For app tables, prefer snake_case and give per-user tables a
-- `user_id TEXT NOT NULL` column (TEXT, not UUID — the preview dev user id is
-- the string 'dev-user'), then scope every query to the authenticated user
-- server-side (see the `neon` + `auth` skills and src/lib/auth/verify.server.ts).

create table if not exists "user" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "name" text not null,
  "email" text not null unique,
  "emailVerified" boolean not null,
  "image" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null
);

create table if not exists "session" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz not null,
  "token" text not null unique,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null,
  "ipAddress" text,
  "userAgent" text,
  "userId" text not null references "user" ("id") on delete cascade
);

create table if not exists "account" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "accountId" text not null,
  "providerId" text not null,
  "userId" text not null references "user" ("id") on delete cascade,
  "accessToken" text,
  "refreshToken" text,
  "idToken" text,
  "accessTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "refreshTokenExpiresAt" timestamptz,
  "scope" text,
  "password" text,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz not null
);

create table if not exists "verification" (
  "id" text not null primary key,
  "identifier" text not null,
  "value" text not null,
  "expiresAt" timestamptz not null,
  "createdAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP not null
);

create index if not exists "session_userId_idx" on "session" ("userId");
create index if not exists "account_userId_idx" on "account" ("userId");
create index if not exists "verification_identifier_idx" on "verification" ("identifier");
===migrations/0002_school.sql
-- School follow-up app schema. All tenant rows hang off school_id;
-- staff.user_id is the Better Auth user id (TEXT).

create table if not exists schools (
  id          serial primary key,
  name        text not null,
  created_by  text not null,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);

create table if not exists staff (
  user_id       text primary key,
  school_id     integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  display_name  text not null,
  role          text not null check (role in ('admin', 'teacher', 'pending')),
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists staff_school_id_idx on staff (school_id);

create table if not exists stages (
  id          serial primary key,
  school_id   integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  name        text not null,
  short_name  text not null,
  sort_order  integer not null default 0
);
create index if not exists stages_school_id_idx on stages (school_id);

create table if not exists classes (
  id          serial primary key,
  school_id   integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  stage_id    integer not null references stages (id) on delete cascade,
  name        text not null,
  sort_order  integer not null default 0
);
create index if not exists classes_stage_id_idx on classes (stage_id);
create index if not exists classes_school_id_idx on classes (school_id);

create table if not exists students (
  id            serial primary key,
  school_id     integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  class_id      integer not null references classes (id) on delete cascade,
  name          text not null,
  parent_phone  text not null default '',
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists students_class_id_idx on students (class_id);
create index if not exists students_school_id_idx on students (school_id);
create index if not exists students_name_idx on students (school_id, name);

create table if not exists notes (
  id           serial primary key,
  school_id    integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  student_id   integer not null references students (id) on delete cascade,
  teacher_id   text not null,
  type         text not null check (type in ('absence', 'late', 'homework', 'behavior')),
  details      text not null default '',
  status       text not null default 'open' check (status in ('open', 'closed')),
  action_taken text not null default '',
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  closed_at    timestamptz,
  closed_by    text
);
create index if not exists notes_school_id_idx on notes (school_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists notes_student_id_idx on notes (student_id);
create index if not exists notes_status_idx on notes (school_id, status);

create table if not exists notifications (
  id          serial primary key,
  school_id   integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  user_id     text not null,
  note_id     integer references notes (id) on delete cascade,
  kind        text not null,
  title       text not null,
  body        text not null,
  tone        text not null default 'amber',
  read        boolean not null default false,
  created_at  timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists notifications_user_idx on notifications (user_id, read, created_at desc);
===migrations/0003_roles_and_behavior.sql
-- Expand staff roles and add a catalog of behavioral violation types.

alter table staff drop constraint if exists staff_role_check;
alter table staff add constraint staff_role_check
  check (role in ('admin', 'teacher', 'counselor', 'pending'));

create table if not exists behavior_types (
  id          serial primary key,
  school_id   integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  name        text not null,
  sort_order  integer not null default 0,
  active      boolean not null default true
);
create index if not exists behavior_types_school_idx on behavior_types (school_id, sort_order);

alter table notes add column if not exists behavior_type_id integer references behavior_types (id) on delete set null;
===migrations/0004_actions_subject_principal.sql
-- Action catalog, teacher subject/phone, and school principal name.

alter table schools add column if not exists principal_name text not null default '';

alter table staff add column if not exists subject text not null default '';
alter table staff add column if not exists phone text not null default '';

create table if not exists action_types (
  id          serial primary key,
  school_id   integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  name        text not null,
  sort_order  integer not null default 0,
  active      boolean not null default true
);
create index if not exists action_types_school_idx on action_types (school_id, sort_order);
===migrations/0005_students_periods_forms.sql
-- Season (summer/winter bell), period on notes, violation degree.

alter table schools add column if not exists season text not null default 'winter';

alter table notes add column if not exists period_key text not null default '';

alter table behavior_types add column if not exists degree integer not null default 1;

===migrations/0008_procedures_messages.sql

===migrations/0009_permissions_messages_improve.sql
-- Teacher visibility / parent-message permissions, logged WhatsApp, behavior improvement.

alter table schools
  add column if not exists teachers_can_message boolean not null default true;
alter table schools
  add column if not exists teachers_can_view_all boolean not null default false;

create table if not exists parent_messages (
  id            serial primary key,
  school_id     integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  student_id    integer not null references students (id) on delete cascade,
  staff_id      text not null,
  kind          text not null default 'general',
  body          text not null,
  parent_phone  text not null default '',
  created_at    timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists parent_messages_school_idx
  on parent_messages (school_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists parent_messages_student_idx
  on parent_messages (student_id);

create table if not exists behavior_improvements (
  id                 serial primary key,
  school_id          integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  student_id         integer not null references students (id) on delete cascade,
  teacher_id         text not null,
  note_id            integer references notes (id) on delete set null,
  plan               text not null,
  teacher_followup   text not null default '',
  counselor_note     text not null default '',
  status             text not null default 'open'
                     check (status in ('open', 'following', 'closed')),
  created_at         timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at         timestamptz not null default now(),
  closed_at          timestamptz,
  closed_by          text
);
create index if not exists improvements_school_idx
  on behavior_improvements (school_id, status, created_at desc);
create index if not exists improvements_student_idx
  on behavior_improvements (student_id);
===migrations/0010_staff_permissions_appearance.sql

  add column if not exists permissions jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb;
alter table staff
  add column if not exists appearance jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb;

alter table schools
  add column if not exists appearance jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb;
===migrations/0011_attendance_counseling.sql
-- Daily full-day attendance, counseling referrals, health notes, violation time.

alter table students
  add column if not exists health_note text not null default '';

alter table notes
  add column if not exists occurred_at timestamptz;
update notes set occurred_at = created_at where occurred_at is null;
alter table notes
  alter column occurred_at set default now();
alter table notes
  alter column occurred_at set not null;

alter table notes
  add column if not exists refer_counselor boolean not null default false;
alter table notes
  add column if not exists suggested_action text not null default '';
alter table notes
  add column if not exists compensation text not null default '';

create table if not exists daily_attendance (
  id           serial primary key,
  school_id    integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  student_id   integer not null references students (id) on delete cascade,
  day          date not null,
  kind         text not null check (kind in ('absence', 'late')),
  excused      boolean not null default false,
  details      text not null default '',
  recorded_by  text not null,
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique (school_id, student_id, day)
);
create index if not exists daily_attendance_day_idx on daily_attendance (school_id, day);
create index if not exists notes_refer_idx on notes (school_id, refer_counselor) where refer_counselor = true;
===migrations/0012_health_cases_arrived.sql
-- Arrival time for morning tardiness, health catalog, teacher-to-counselor cases.

alter table daily_attendance
  add column if not exists arrived_at timestamptz;

create table if not exists health_conditions (
  id           serial primary key,
  school_id    integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  name         text not null,
  sort_order   integer not null default 0,
  active       boolean not null default true,
  unique (school_id, name)
);
create index if not exists health_conditions_school_idx on health_conditions (school_id, sort_order);

create table if not exists counseling_cases (
  id           serial primary key,
  school_id    integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  student_id   integer not null references students (id) on delete cascade,
  author_id    text not null,
  kind         text not null check (kind in ('health', 'psych', 'learning')),
  body         text not null default '',
  created_at   timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index if not exists counseling_cases_school_idx on counseling_cases (school_id, created_at desc);

===migrations/0017_roles_messages_improve.sql
-- Extra school job titles, deactivate staff, custom WhatsApp templates,
-- and a catalog of behaviors a teacher can pick when starting an improvement plan.

alter table staff drop constraint if exists staff_role_check;
alter table staff add constraint staff_role_check
  check (role in (
    'admin',
    'principal',
    'school_vp',
    'teachers_vp',
    'counselor',
    'student_counselor',
    'health_counselor',
    'activity_leader',
    'teacher',
    'pending'
  ));

alter table staff add column if not exists active boolean not null default true;

alter table schools add column if not exists custom_messages jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb;

create table if not exists improvement_options (
  id           serial primary key,
  school_id    integer not null references schools (id) on delete cascade,
  name         text not null,
  sort_order   integer not null default 0,
  active       boolean not null default true,
  unique (school_id, name)
);
create index if not exists improvement_options_school_idx on improvement_options (school_id, sort_order);
===migrations/0018_print_logo_schedules.sql

===migrations/0019_staff_extra_roles.sql
-- Extra operational job titles on staff.

alter table staff drop constraint if exists staff_role_check;
alter table staff add constraint staff_role_check
  check (role in (
    'admin',
    'principal',
    'school_vp',
    'teachers_vp',
    'counselor',
    'student_counselor',
    'health_counselor',
    'activity_leader',
    'teacher',
    'security',
    'admin_assistant',
    'admin_staff',
    'pending'
  ));
